about_the_game:
ALISA WAKES UP IN A GRAVE, HER FAMILY AND HOUSE GONE

What's happened in this abandoned little town?

Play as Alisa, an 18-yea﻿rs-old girl that just moved to Lindcliff, an American locale forgotten by the government and shrouded in fog. Her parents got their own problems to worry about and her brother is determined to make her life miserable. Her sister Adelina, the only one who actually cared, has disappeared, leaving nothing behind but questions. Will Alisa meet the same fate?

Follow the story with Alisa and unravel the secrets of the world she used to know.

What happens next is up to you.

DEVELOP A PERSONALITY

  • Start as a shy and innocent girl and decide the way she develops. Will she remain pure or become corrupted by her lust?

  • Alisa can be lewd or pure, dominant or submissive, smart or stupid, strong or graceful

  • 16 types of playstyles based on attributes and different decisions

CHOICES MATTER

  • Shape Alisa's character and appearance through gameplay choices

  • Sexual encounters, food, weather, sports, cosmetics, and more can affect her appearance

SOCIAL SURV﻿IVAL

  • Reputation: Alisa's interactions with NPCs impact her reputation within Lindcliff. If she steals, gets caught in compromising situations or makes enemies, NPCs may refuse to help her, turning Lindcliff into a more hostile place. Nowhere is safe

  • Trust & Betrayal: Gaining trust of key NPCs might grant Alisa protection, food, or safe places to rest. However, NPCs might betray her if they think she’s more valuable as a prisoner or a forced laborer

  • Assault Risks: Being naked or wearing provocative clothing raises the risk of unwanted attention, leading to sexual assaults or being coerced into dangerous situations

  • Keep Alisa happy and satisfied as well as tending to her regular needs: energy, hunger, arousal and others

  • Find your own ways to get food and shelter, make friends or enemies

  • Wear multiple layers of clothing based on the weather and your own preferences

  • Exhibitionism: Gradually unlock the ability to wear more revealing clothes... or no clothes at all!

  • A large list of fetish-specific poses can be unlocked the more Alisa's fetishes evolve

  • Loads of sex-related attributes, like cum coverage, cloth sexiness; anus, pussy, nipples skills and wear etc...

MAKE IT YOUR WAY

UNIQUE NPCs

  • The NPCs have unique personalities, quests and reactions to your actions and looks. Will you make friends or foes? Charm your way through or intimidate everyone?

OPEN-WORLD

  • Explore a vastly populated world covered by cities, lakes, mountains, rivers and forests

  • Discover hidden secrets and engaging quests
